title: Robotics Technicians
description: Build, install, test, or maintain robotic equipment or related automated production systems.

projection.title: Electro-mechanical and mechatronics technologists and technicians

tasks.text: Make repairs to robots or peripheral equipment, such as replacement of defective circuit boards, sensors, controllers, encoders, or servomotors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on electronic equipment repair

tasks.text: Troubleshoot robotic systems, using knowledge of microprocessors, programmable controllers, electronics, circuit analysis, mechanics, sensor or feedback systems, hydraulics, or pneumatics.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Root-cause hypotheses; human verifies in the field

dwas.name: Determine causes of operational problems or failures.

tasks.text: Install, program, or repair programmable controllers, robot controllers, end-of-arm tools, or conveyors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Robot programming requires physical calibration and testing

tasks.text: Maintain service records of robotic equipment or automated production systems.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain records systems; human owns integrity

dwas.name: Maintain operational records or records systems.

tasks.text: Modify computer-controlled robot movements.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Robot programming requires physical calibration and testing

tasks.text: Perform preventive or corrective maintenance on robotic systems or components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on electromechanical maintenance

tasks.text: Align, fit, or assemble components, using hand tools, power tools, fixtures, templates, or microscopes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Assembling components is physical hands-on work

tasks.text: Attach wires between controllers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Assembling components is physical hands-on work

tasks.text: Evaluate the efficiency and reliability of industrial robotic systems, reprogramming or calibrating to achieve maximum quantity and quality.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Equipment specs analysis aided; physical testing human

dwas.name: Evaluate characteristics of equipment or systems.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Test performance of robotic assemblies, using instruments such as oscilloscopes, electronic voltmeters, or bridges.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI interprets results; human runs physical tests

dwas.name: Test performance of electrical, electronic, mechanical, or integrated systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Train customers or other personnel to install, use, or maintain robots.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Operational procedure training needs live demonstration

dwas.name: Train personnel on proper operational procedures.

tasks.text: Build or assemble robotic devices or systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Assembling components is physical hands-on work

tasks.text: Document robotics test procedures and results.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document test results from provided data

dwas.name: Document design or operational test results.

tasks.text: Assist engineers in the design, configuration, or application of robotic systems.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts electromechanical designs; engineer verifies

dwas.name: Design electromechanical equipment or systems.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Install new robotic systems in stationary positions or on tracks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Production equipment installation is physical trade work

tasks.text: Program complex robotic systems, such as vision systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Robot programming requires physical calibration and testing

tasks.text: Develop robotic path motions to maximize efficiency, safety, and quality.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Robot programming requires physical calibration and testing

tasks.text: Fabricate housings, jigs, fittings, or fixtures, using metalworking machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Machine tool operation is hands-on skilled work

dwas.name: Fabricate products or components using machine tools.

tasks.text: Train robots, using artificial intelligence software or interactive training techniques, to perform simple or complex tasks, such as designing and carrying out a series of iterative tests of chemical samples.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Robot programming requires physical calibration and testing

tasks.text: Inspect installation sites.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical site verification against specs is human

dwas.name: Inspect facilities or sites to determine if they meet specifications or standards.

tasks.text: Maintain inventories of robotic production supplies, such as sensors or cables.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Develop three-dimensional simulations of automation systems.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Drafting diagrams aided; engineering validity needs human

dwas.name: Create graphical representations of industrial production systems.
